artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: charcoal with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, showcasing a serene scene with a strip of land, a body of water, a distant structure on the horizon, and a cluster of trees on a slope to the right. The artwork features soft, sketch-like brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of gray.

artworks.title: Little Venice
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape across a body of water. The style is reminiscent of an etching or ink drawing with fine lines and minimal details. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black ink on a cream background. In the foreground, there are vertical posts in the water, leading the eye towards the distant city with small boats and buildings visible against the water.

artworks.title: The Dancing Girl
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a person standing with a slight lean. The facial features are sketchily drawn, with an abstract depiction of the face. The person's hair is suggested with light strokes. They are draped in a flowing, translucent garment. One hand is visible and articulated with light strokes. The background is plain and undetailed.

artworks.title: Sketch of Cellini's "Perseus"
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent, after Benvenuto Cellini
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a sculpture painted in shades of blue and gray. The sculpture portrays a nude man standing triumphantly over a fallen figure, holding a severed head in one hand and a long sword in the other. The man appears to have something on his head that may be a helmet. The sculpture faces the left, and we see it in profile. The background is tan, with some areas of pale blue and brown.

artworks.title: River Wye
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with an elevated view. Chepstow Castle ruins are in the distance amidst dense foliage. Cows are on the grassy bank, and two figures swim in the river. A small boat is further along the waterway. The drawing features fine line work and a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and white wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. To the left, there is an arched stone bridge over a small stream, framed by lush trees. In the background, there are faint outlines of a bridge and rolling hills under a soft, muted sky. The color palette consists of soft browns, grays, and bluish tones. The technique emphasizes atmospheric depth and natural serenity.

artworks.title: Novi Belgii Novaeque Angliae nec non Pennsylvaniae et partis Virginiae tabula multis in locis emendata
artworks.medium: engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a historical map of the Northeastern United States and surrounding areas. The antique map features detailed illustrations of land masses, rivers, settlements, and decorative elements. Various regions such as NOVA BELGICA and NIEUW NEDERLANDT are labeled, along with artistic representations of animals like beavers and deer. Pictorial elements include a cityscape at the bottom, possibly representing New Amsterdam, and a decorative cartouche featuring figures and a ship. The geography is shown in a stylized manner typical of cartographic works from the period, with lines indicating colonial borders and paths of exploration.

artworks.title: Solomon Worshipping False Gods
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.5 x 15.7 cm (7 5/16 x 6 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures inside a softly lit, narrow, arched-roof room with large windows. Both individuals are presented in full view, with the female figure standing and the male figure kneeling. The woman has her hair styled elegantly with a braided knot on top of her head and adorned with a decorative band. She wears a long, flowing gown with layered sleeves and a fitted bodice. Her facial features are delicately etched, capturing a serene expression. The man, seen from the back, has short curly hair and wears a similar long garment. He appears to be in a posture of supplication, with hands clasped in prayer. The woman is pointing towards a small sculpture on a pedestal beside a window, which depicts a nude male figure with one hand raised. Through the windows, a scenic view of a landscape with distant towers, trees, and a river can be observed. The room is simply furnished with wooden walls and an austere floor.

artworks.title: Nocturne: Salute
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate): 15.3 x 22.7 cm (6 x 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a calm body of water with a high horizon line revealing a distant landmass or city. The drawing features delicate lines, creating an unfinished or ethereal look. Horizontal lines suggest gentle ripples in the water. Near the right side, an indistinct shape resembling a rowing boat is visible. The color palette consists of muted sepia tones, evoking a sense of nostalgia.

artworks.title: Intemperance
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person holding a snake. The person has long hair, closed eyes, and wears ornate clothing with a headscarf and a comb. The background includes a fortified structure with a tower and foliage.

artworks.title: Joachim Patinir
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century or Attributed to Cornelis Cort after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man facing slightly to the right. He has deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a strong jaw. He wears a large hat that covers most of his head, along with a high-collared garment and a draped coat. The background is textured with horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Gothic Letter "d"
artworks.description: This drawing features gothic architectural design elements, including pointed arches, intricate tracery, and decorative spires. The design showcases ornate and elaborate features typically found in gothic cathedrals or churches. The precise linework emphasizes verticality and decoration, with finials and crockets visible along the structures.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person depicted from the knees up in a reclining position with their arms raised and bound by ropes to a vertical surface. The individual has a youthful face with pronounced cheekbones and wavy, shoulder-length hair. They are unclothed except for a draped cloth around their waist and there is no visible jewelry. The background features a textured surface, possibly a tree or wooden post, with some foliage visible.

artworks.title: Eugène Rouher
artworks.description: The illustration features a person standing behind a podium. The figure is leaning forward, holding papers and a glass. The person has exaggerated facial features and short dark hair. They are dressed in a formal suit. In the background, there are faint outlines of an audience in a courtroom or assembly room.

artworks.title: R.P.L. Ségur d'Aguesseau
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man sitting on a bench. He is in a side profile with his hands clasped around his knees. The man has exaggerated facial features and wavy hair. He wears a dark jacket over checkered pants. The background is a plain wall and a shaded floor.

artworks.title: M.L.P.F. Esquirou de Parieu
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing sideways on a raised platform or podium, reading from a piece of paper. The man has exaggerated facial features, wearing a dark suit with a high-collared shirt and bow tie. He appears focused as an indistinct crowd surrounds him. The background indicates a lecture or speech setting. The man holds the paper as he reads, with no visible jewelry or additional objects in sight.

artworks.title: Achille Fould
artworks.description: The illustration features a man with an exaggeratedly large head standing upright with his arms crossed over his chest. The man has a serious expression, dark, slicked-back hair, and is dressed in a dark, long coat with matching pants and shoes. In the background, there are faint outlines of multiple people and a figure on a podium or platform. The background is sketched with loose, light lines suggesting depth and perspective.

artworks.title: H.M. Augustin Corne
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man in a suit with a bow tie, holding a glass while leaning on a pedestal. The man has exaggerated features, including a large nose and chin. He has neatly styled hair and round spectacles.

artworks.title: Ferdinand Favre
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body caricature of a person in profile, striding to the right with an exaggerated posture. The figure has a large head with distinct facial features such as a long nose, pronounced brow, closed eyes, large lips, and voluminous hair styled in waves. The person wears a dark suit with stripes, a white shirt, and is set against a background of faceless figures. No accessories or objects are depicted in the image.

artworks.title: Prince Lucien Murat
artworks.description: The image shows a man in formal 19th-century attire standing with a slight turn to his body, facing the viewer. He has a stylized mustache and goatee, short-cropped hair, and a relaxed expression. He wears a dark suit jacket, white shirt with a high collar, striped trousers, and holds a walking stick with one hand while the other rests on his belly. A top hat is held behind his back. The background is a simple, shaded design that does not depict any specific scenery.

artworks.title: J. Marie Joseph Deville
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a person sitting on a bench or ledge. The person is seated with one leg crossed over the other. The individual's facial features are exaggerated, with a prominent nose, full lips, and large, intense eyes. The hair is tousled and appears wavy. They are wearing a dark jacket and lighter-colored pants, with the jacket flowing over the side of the bench. The person's posture adds to the overall dramatic effect created by the image. The background is minimally detailed, mostly consisting of shaded lines that suggest depth and contrast against the lighter areas.

artworks.title: Félix Saint-Priest
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person standing upright. The person has exaggerated facial features, with a long, elongated face and pronounced nose. The hair is messy and stands up at various angles. They are wearing round spectacles that appear quite large. The clothing consists of a dark, buttoned uniform, and the person is holding a box or chest in their hands. An envelope is visible in their grasp. In the background, there are sketches of several figures, likely a crowd, drawn in a lighter pencil. The setting appears to be busy, with various expressions and postures depicted among the background figures. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic pencil sketch style.

artworks.title: J.-B. Gustave de Laboulie
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man with exaggerated proportions. He has a small body and a large head, with a receding hairline, short hair, and round spectacles. The man is dressed in a dark suit with a patterned texture, including a jacket, trousers, and a tie. His facial features include a prominent nose and slightly pursed lips. The background is a plain surface with indistinct lines for shading. There is a signature in the lower left corner and the number '53' in the lower right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Marie Denis Larabit
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body caricature of a man seated on a ledge or step. The man is sideways to the viewer, with crossed legs and arms folded. He has exaggerated facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in a dark suit with striped trousers and formal shoes. A piece of fabric, possibly a handkerchief, is beside him on the ledge. The background is lightly sketched, indicating a simple setting.
